purpose: Teach: 西川/横山/藤本/新田/飯田/西尾/木下/秋山

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 西川部長の歓迎会を来週設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a welcome reception for Director Nishikawa for next week.
lines.style: Efficient, organized tone. Slight lift at the beginning—decisive without rushing. Clear and confident. The cadence of someone running through a checklist who knows exactly what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。横山課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the handover documentation from Manager Yokoyama.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Steady pace, slightly quieter than Yuki—a note of attentiveness. No hesitation, just a quiet 'noted' quality underneath the yes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 藤本社長のご来社時のスケジュールを整えましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure President Fujimoto's site visit is properly scheduled.
lines.style: Purposeful and clear. Similar efficiency to the first line but with a slight emphasis on precision—this matters more. No rush, just focus. Small pause before the verb, as if mentally checking the importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新田主任の研修教材を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the training materials for Supervisor Nitta.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Steady, unrushed. The tone of someone taking down another task without making it feel like a burden. Almost meditative in its calm acceptance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 飯田取締役の最終出社日に花束を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare flowers for Director Iida's last day at the office.
lines.style: Thoughtful and slightly softer than the previous direction lines. There's care underneath—this is about recognition and farewell, not just logistics. A gentle emphasis on 'flowers,' like she's imagining the gesture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。西尾広報部の月次報告を受け取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll collect the monthly report from the PR department—Nishio.
lines.style: Steady, focused. Kenji's in his rhythm now—several tasks deep. The pace is even, almost meditative. A tiny breath before the name, like mentally organizing the stack of things to do.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 木下人事に新規募集の打ち合わせを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's reach out to HR—Kinoshita—and set up a meeting about the new recruitment push.
lines.style: Same efficient clarity as Yuki's other direction lines, but with a slight conversational warmth. She's delegating confidently but not coldly. A tiny pause before 'meeting,' as if visualizing the conversation ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。秋山技術部のプロジェクト進捗を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check on the project progress from the technical team—Akiyama.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Kenji's pace here is slightly slower—a natural winding down. The tone stays steady but with a subtle sense of completion, like the last item on the list. Grounded and sure.
